lcc_original: 永恆主上帝呼喚那人說：『你在哪裏？』
notes: 耶和華(WH03068) → 永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of יהוה
神(WH0430) → 上帝: LCC's standard rendering of אֱלֹהִים (systematic difference from UNV)
{<WAH0413>} stays implicit: LCC likewise omits an explicit preposition before 那人, mirroring UNV's implicit marker for אֶל
UNV's 對他<WAH09001>說 → LCC's 說{<WAH09001>}: LCC omits explicit 'to him' (לוֹ), so WAH09001 kept implicit and placed after the verb 說 to preserve Hebrew clause order (וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ)
